P.name: Fleet of Foot
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Sivir's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} and {{tip|ability}} hits against enemy {{tip|champions}} grant her {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|changedisplay=true|55 to 75 for 5|1;6;11;16;18}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.

Q.name: Boomerang Blade
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sivir''' hurls her crossblade in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within its path, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 40|critScaling=true}}.
Q.description2: ''Boomerang Blade's'' damage is reduced by {{pp|key=%|changedisplay=true|type=non-champions hit|0 to 60 for 5|0 to 4|formula=100%-(15%*Nº of non-champions hit). ''This is capped at 40% damage at 4 enemies hit.''}}. Upon reaching maximum range, the crossblade returns to her, resetting the damage modifier and dealing the same damage to enemies on its way back.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Minimum Damage|{{ap|60*0.4 to 160*0.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*0.4}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 24% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Maximum Champion Damage|{{ap|60*2 to 160*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''
Q.cast time: {{as|{{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|round=3|0.25;0.231;0.198;0.165;0.132;0.1|key1=%|0;15.2;41.6;68;94.4;120|formula=0.25*(1-(0.5 per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)). ''This is capped at 60% reduction at 120% '''bonus''' attack speed.''}}|attack speed}}

W.name: Ricochet
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sivir''' empowers her crossblade for the next 4 seconds, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and causing her {{tip|basic attacks}} to bounce to additional surrounding enemies, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to them. If the triggering attack {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}}, the bounces will do so as well for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Sivir|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage. ''Ricochet'' deals 65% damage against {{tip|minions}} and executes them if they would be left below {{sti|{{as|15 health}}}}.
W.description2: Bounces occur only up to 8 times and can target each enemy up to one additional time per empowered attack. They prioritize the nearest new target, then the nearest target if no new targets are available.
W.description3: ''Ricochet {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sivir's''' basic attack timer if it was {{tt|not already active|See notes}}. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be bounced to.''

E.name: Spell Shield
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sivir''' gains a {{tip|spell shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Upon successfully blocking a hostile effect, she {{tip|heals}} herself and activates ''{{ai|Fleet of Foot|Sivir}}'' after {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

R.name: On the Hunt
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sivir''' gains ''On the Hunt'' for a duration and grants it to nearby allied champions for the remaining duration.
R.description3: While active, '''Sivir's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} reduce her basic abilities' {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} by {{fd|0.5}} seconds each.
R.description4: '''Sivir''' can refresh the duration of her ''On the Hunt'' buff whenever she scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them.
